name: app-tall-twelve-screen-hotel-booking-flow-sheet-in-lavender
title: Twelve-Screen Hotel Booking Flow Sheet
whatItIs: A lavender sheet of twelve phones in three rows, the top row cropped: hotel detail, room list, date picker, booking details form, payment details, booking confirmed, my bookings and profile, all in soft blue and white with rounded cards.
whatItMeans: A dense grid with a cropped top row shows how far the flow goes, and the constant blue keeps it unified.
techniques: Cropped top row implying more screens
Blue gradient primary buttons on every screen
Step tracker on each form screen
Black active pill in the tab bar

vocabulary.definition: A row of screens cut off at the edge to imply more.
Dots and labels showing progress through a flow.
A black highlighted item in a tab bar.
